newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY POLICE ANNOUNCE ARRESTS IN BOMBING WAVE.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY POLICE ANNOUNCE ARRESTS IN BOMBING WAVE.

text.p: Hungarian police on Friday said they had arrested two suspects in a wave of recent bombings outside nightclubs and restaurants in Budapest and confiscated a large quantity of explosives and weapons.

The two men were arrested on November 5 and an arsenal including handguns, 1,000 rounds of ammunition, seven hand grenades, 2.5 kgs (5.5 lb) of plastic explosives, silencers and a timing device were confiscated during a house search, police said.
"One of the handgrenades was of the same type as the one used in the bombing of the Leroy Country Pub on Wednesday," Colonel Janos Lazar of the Hungarian National Police told a news conference.
No one has been injured in the bombings which police have attributed to a gangland war, but the incidents have heightened tension in the city which is a popular tourist destination.
Police identified the suspects only by their first names as Peter S., 25, and Lajos R., no age.
Police said they arrested Peter S. as he purchased handguns and grenades from Lajos R. and later discovered the cache of explosives at a house used by Peter S.
